turns.question: It's 12 October 2026. What are our sales in Germany so far this month?
turns.answer: Sales is ambiguous, so here are both for Germany (customer country DE) from 1 to 12 October 2026: revenue (gross) EUR 533.75 and net revenue (revenue minus partner returns) EUR 494.00. Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
